# Semester HQ

> Semester HQ is an all-in-one planner for college students. A student uploads their syllabus PDF and the semester is built for them in about a minute: class times, every assignment and exam date, the professor's contact details, office hours, the attendance limit and the late policy. That removes the hour of manual data entry that kills most planners before week three. Around it, Semester HQ puts classes, deadlines, exam prep, projects, flashcards, notes, study groups, club and team calendars, and internship applications into one connected app, replacing the separate tools students normally juggle each semester (LMS, calendar app, syllabus PDFs, group chats, notes apps, spreadsheets).

## Pricing

- Live demo: the full interface runs in the browser with no account, including a sample semester, study group, and club. Nothing is saved; it resets on reload.
- Semester HQ Plus: $7.99/month, billed monthly, cancel anytime, 14-day money-back guarantee on the first charge. Saves the semester and syncs across devices, and unlocks syllabus upload, shared classes, study groups, and club and team calendars.
- Group plans for clubs, sports teams, sorority and fraternity chapters, classes, and departments: $5.99 per member per month (5 member minimum), bought and managed at https://app.semester-hq.com/group-admin.html. Details: https://semester-hq.com/group-pricing.html. Whole departments or campuses: hello@semester-hq.com.

## Features

Listed with the two that matter most first: syllabus upload is why a student starts, and the class page is why they stay.

- Syllabus upload (PDF, photo, or text): fills in class times, assignments, exam dates, professor contact info, office hours, TAs, and attendance and late work policies. Everything is editable, and the original file is kept so it can be re-read later.
- Class pages: one page per class with what's due, the next exam, office hours, policies, notes, flashcards, and a private absence tracker against the attendance limit ("1 of 3 allowed absences used").
- Quick add in plain English: "bio lab report fri 5pm" becomes a lab for that class due Friday at 5 PM.
- Calendar with month, week, day, and year views, color-coded by class, including class meetings, deadlines, study sessions, project milestones, and club events.
- Shared classes: one student shares a class; classmates join by code, link, or school search and get every deadline, and updates follow. Only the schedule is shared, never progress, notes, or absences.
- Assignments grouped by overdue, today, tomorrow, and this week; to-do lists by date or custom lists, with repeating to-dos.
- Exam prep: live countdowns, a topic checklist rated not yet, shaky, or got it, study sessions placed on the calendar, and topics pulled from a study guide.
- Projects: templates (research paper, group presentation, lab report, case study, portfolio, capstone) with milestones spaced to the due date, tasks, team, links, notes, and a timeline.
- Flashcards with spaced repetition.
- Study timer with focus blocks, a session goal, and a weekly study goal.
- Notebook with rich text, organized by class.
- Study groups: find-a-time availability heatmap, sessions with RSVPs, shared tasks, shared notes and decks, and group chat.
- Clubs & Teams: officers post events (including weekly repeats and required events) and announcements; members RSVP and get events on their own calendar.
- Applications tracker for internships, jobs, scholarships, and research positions, with deadlines on the calendar.
- Heads Up: an in-app panel behind the bell listing what's overdue, due today and tomorrow, exams coming up, study sessions, club events, project milestones, and flashcards due. Semester HQ sends no notifications of any kind: no push, no browser permission prompt, nothing on a lock screen.
- Quick capture: photograph a whiteboard or assignment sheet to turn it into tasks; Android share target for PDFs and links.
- Works offline and installs to the phone home screen as a web app.
- Themes with matching dark modes, seasonal limited editions, and alternate app icons.
- Semester Wrapped: an end-of-term recap as shareable story cards.
- Semester HQ does not track grades or GPA.

## Privacy

- The live demo keeps nothing after the tab closes.
- Signed-in planner data is stored in a database tied to the account so it syncs across devices.
- Documents uploaded for syllabus reading or quick capture are sent to Anthropic's Claude API to extract details. Anthropic does not use them to train models and does not keep them beyond its API data retention policy. The original syllabus file is kept in the student's class page until the student deletes it or their account.
- No data is sold, and no third-party ad trackers run inside the app.
- Full policy: https://semester-hq.com/privacy.html
